definition: to fasten something onto a ring
description: On a flooded country lane in the rain, a young bride in a muddy cream wedding dress crouches barefoot in the water at the front of an old white car and fastens a heavy steel hook on a tow cable onto the car's bumper. She then stands up and walks away, and the cable pulls tight through the brown floodwater towards a tractor further down the lane. Guests in suits and a bridesmaid with a bouquet sit barefoot on the car roof and clap, and white swans swim in the water behind.
